messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: ALERT: gpu-inference-west2a high alloc-fail rate detected, GPU OOM spikes across multiple pools. metric: cuda_alloc_failures > 200/min. severity: P1. PagerDuty incident INC-98732 created.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: page fired to rotation @jamie (on-call). Incident INC-98732 | service: gpu-inference-west2a | triggers: cuda_alloc_fail | runbook: gpu-oom-evac. Link: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/INC-98732
jamie: ack. I'm up. pulling logs and checking pool topology.
jamie: quick check: `kubectl get pods -n inference -o wide --selector=pool=west2a` shows several pods in CrashLoopBackOff with errors allocating GPU memory.
jamie: logs snippet: ```2026-03-15T08:12:05Z ERR cuda: out of memory allocating 2048MB for tensor kv_cache
2026-03-15T08:12:06Z WARN evict: evicted 3 cached prefixes to free 1.2GiB
2026-03-15T08:12:07Z ERR runtime: allocation failed: no CUDA memory available
```
liam: I see the same in metrics. west2a pool fragmentation + sudden burst from rerun jobs. multiple customers hitting long-context chat flows.
liam: suggestion: immediate mitigation = reduce batch size on hot routes + enable model-fallback policy to quantized-variant (gptx-small-q). Can we flip fallback?
jamie: +1. sara, can you push the route override for the chartless rollout?
sara: doing it now. patching routing-policy: ```/api/v1/routes/override POST {"route":"/v1/chat","region":"west2a","fallback_model":"gptx-small-q","max_batch_tokens":512}```
sara: pushing... :rocket:
pagerduty-bot: Note: auto-escalation timer paused for 10m while mitigation in progress.
nikita: I'm on standby; if you want I can start draining noisy nodes and reroute traffic to west2b.
jamie: yes please. nikita, start drain for node gpu-w2a-07 and gpu-w2a-09 to trigger allocation stabilization. use `drain-and-evict --grace 30s --force`.
nikita: running drain now. command output: ```drain-and-evict gpu-w2a-07 -> success (pods rescheduled)
drain-and-evict gpu-w2a-09 -> success (pods rescheduled)```
liam: I'm also scaling up dedicated fallback pool in west2b by +4 GPUs. `redwoodctl capacity allocate --region=west2b --pool=fallback --gpus=4`
alex: starting traffic reroute canary to west2b for 10% of traffic. monitor latency and 5xxs.
jamie: telemetry shows 502 spike for tenant acme-corp around the time of the burst. acme 5xx rate peaked +18%. we should notify their AE.
nikita: noting customer impact. I'll ping AE @maria and Solutions. message: "We're mitigating a GPU allocation incident in west2a; you may see intermittent 502s for a subset of requests. We're rerouting and scaling fallback now."
jamie: good. I'm going to put short-term actions in the incident tracker: 1) keep fallback enabled 2) complete drains 3) monitor for 15m 4) schedule pool defragment job if stable.
jamie: handoff: I need to step out for a quick personal call in ~18 minutes. nikita, can you own post-mitigation checks and incident update?
nikita: I will take it after your call. please leave me the checklist.
jamie: checklist pasted: ```- confirm cuda_alloc_failures < 10/min
- customer 5xxs back to baseline
- no CrashLoopBackOff pods in pool west2a
- create follow-up ticket for pool compaction/defrag
- run leak detection job on latest runtime build```
nikita: got it. I'll update INC-98732 and notify SRE rotation.
pagerduty-bot: INC-98732 updated: mitigation steps applied (route-fallback + node drains + fallback pool scale). auto-escalation resumed.
liam: metrics coming down — cuda_alloc_failures down to 48/min and trending downward. KV cache evictions reduced.
jamie: thanks team. I'll be back in 20m. nikita please escalate to infra if we see >200 again.
nikita: ack. taking lead. I'll post updates in this thread.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty: incident INC-98732 acknowledged by jamie. Escalation window suspended until 2026-03-15T08:35:00Z.
incident-bot: Follow-up note auto-added to INC-98732: "mitigation: route-fallback applied; nodes drained; fallback pool scaled; monitoring for 30m"
nikita: quick status update 08:28: cuda_alloc_failures 22/min, acme 5xxs back to +2% above baseline. continuing observation.
ajamie: (after return) thanks for taking over - looks stable. I'll run the defrag job in next maintenance window and open a postmortem if we see recurrence. :thumbsup:
nikita: closing immediate mitigation. leaving detailed notes in INC-98732. will hand back to rotation at end of shift.
pagerduty-bot: INC-98732 resolved automatically (no new alerts for 15m). Please confirm and close the incident if OK.
jamie: closing. resolved. good job everyone. :tada:
